title: Presentation Designer/Graphic Designer
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Presentation Designer / Graphic Designer

Location: Remote (PST Hour shift)

Job Type: Contract (06+ Months Contract)

Schedule: Mon - Fri (20hours/week)

Job Summary:

Project Specifics – Our client is seeking a Presentation designer to assist with 2 different types of slides: Go-To-Market (GTM) PowerPoint PPT slides, and investor bridge funding slides. They will be adding and refactoring slides, there may be a bit of branding work, and updates on existing slides.

Desired Skills -

• Visual eye, for marketing and collateral decks...

• Need someone who has flexibility, who can quickly work on new decks and retro the others

• Creates visually compelling slide decks for internal and external audiences.

• Aligns visuals with GTM strategy, brand messaging, and campaign goals.

• Ensures consistency with brand identity across all pitch materials.

• Translates complex ideas into digestible visual formats.

Must Haves -

• Has experience working with fast-paced executives and a can adjust on the fly for quick turnarounds

• Has autonomy and flexibility in work schedule to jump on a call and to push our work with little notice

• Has proven deep in experience with Microsoft PowerPoint and has created visual decks with this format

• Working knowledge with Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign (for custom visuals, icons, and layout finesse)

• Use of hierarchy, whitespace, and typography to guide attention

• Deep understanding of brand guidelines (color, tone, logo usage)

• Mastery of slide composition, font pairing, and alignment
